def vqe_heh_plus_sto3g():

    driver = PySCFDriver(atom=r'He 0 0 0; H 0 0 0.7743', unit=Aer.get_default_unit(), charge=0, spin=0, basis='sto3g')

    molecular_hamiltonian = driver.run()

    mapper = JordanWignerMapper()

    pauli_hamiltonian = PauliSumOp()
    pauli_hamiltonian += SparsePauliOp.from_list([('II', -2.14314), ('ZZ', -0.32658), ('ZZ', -0.32658), ('XX', 0.18093), ('YY', 0.18093)])

    # Create a parameterized ansatz
    ansatz = QuantumCircuit(2)
    ansatz.h(0)
    ansatz.cx(0, 1)
    ansatz.rz(0, 1)
    ansatz.cx(0, 1)
    ansatz.rz(1, 1)
    ansatz.cx(0, 1)
    ansatz.ry(0, 1)

    vqe_circuit = QuantumCircuit(2)
    vqe_circuit.append(ansatz, range(2))
